final_message:
Configured the 31 authoritative zones on pc1–pc31 as requested, with 30 delegations and their glue records. pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) is the recursive resolver; pc33–pc40 use it as clients.

Created BIND configuration and zone files, appended DNS startup commands, and changed the images of pc1–pc32 to `kathara/bind`. Existing links, IP addresses, and routes were left unchanged.

`www.example.com` points to pc6, since no separate web host was specified. Both requested MX records and mail-host A records are present.

Static checks passed for the zone mappings, delegations, glue, clients, and router LAN routes. `named-checkzone` and `named-checkconf` were unavailable, and live Kathara resolution was not tested.
